units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 4:1">Pesik. R. s. 4</cite>, end <he>פָּעֲרָה החרובית עצמה וכ׳</he> a carob tree opened itself and swallowed him.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 119:32">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXIX, 131</cite> <he>פָּעַרְתִּי פי לתורתך</he> I open my mouth for thy Law; <he>כשם שפּוֹעֲרִים … למלקוש</he> as people open their mouth for the late rain (to inhale it); a. e.

senses.gloss: to uncover (one’s self), esp. to commit a nuisance before the idol Peor.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 7:6">Snh. VII, 6</cite> <he>הפּוֹעֵר עצמו לבעל פעור וכ׳</he> he who uncovers himself before Baal Peor (is guilty, for) this is the mode of worshipping him.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 526:1">Yalk. Hos. 526</cite> <he>כלום … אלא שתִּפְעוֹר עצמך לו</he> they ask of thee only that thou uncover thyself before him.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 64a:13">Snh. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>פ׳ בפניו</he> he eased himself before him; a. fr.
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 131:2">Sifré Num. 131</cite> <he>המְפַעֵר עצמו לבעל פעור</he>, v. supra.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 44b:8">Ab. Zar. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>שמְפַעֲרִין לפניו וכ׳</he> before whom they commit a nuisance every day.
